summary: Specified experimental ICMP messages that let a host ask what fully qualified domain name belongs to an IP address. It was an alternative to doing a reverse lookup in the Domain Name System. It is now historic and is listed as obsoleted by RFC 6918.

eli5.summary: You know a house number and want to know the family name. This asked the network a question to find out the name that goes with a number.

questions: how to get a domain name from an ip address with icmp
what are icmp domain name messages
